---
title: "Results"
description: "Retrieve verification decisions and check results."
---

Retrieve results through [GET /v1/scans/{scan_id}](/external/api/get-scan) with `scans:read`. The response includes the scan’s progress and available results for its enabled checks.

## Completion callbacks

| Callback | Trigger |
| --- | --- |
| `onCaptureComplete(scanId)` | All required captures have been accepted. |
| `onComplete(scanId)` | Processing has finished. |

`onComplete` signals processing completion, not an accepted verification decision. Use it to trigger result retrieval on your backend.

## Verification

| `verification.decision` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DECISION_ACCEPT` | Accepted under the venue’s verification policy. |
| `DECISION_REJECT` | Rejected under the venue’s verification policy. |
| `DECISION_VERIFY` | Requires further verification or review. |
| `DECISION_UNSPECIFIED` | No decision available. |

| `verification.integrity` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `INTEGRITY_REAL` | No evidence of a fake document detected. |
| `INTEGRITY_POSSIBLY_FAKE` | Potential document inconsistency detected. |
| `INTEGRITY_FAKE` | Evidence of a fake document detected. |
| `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_REAL` | Additional verification confirmed the document details. |
| `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_FAKE` | Additional verification contradicted the document details. |
| `INTEGRITY_UNSPECIFIED` | No assessment available. |

`of_age` and `not_expired` report positive age and expiration checks. A `false` value does not distinguish a failed check from an unavailable check.

## Additional checks

The response can include `document`, `identity`, and `lists`. Fields depend on the checks enabled for the scan; pending or unavailable results are omitted. See the [scan response schema](/external/api/get-scan) for individual fields.

Use [List scans](/external/api/list-scans) to retrieve scan history, then retrieve each scan for its details.
